Road conditions

  • (877)511-4662-Road conditions
  • https://tims.ncdot.gov/tims/ (Road conditions/ construction maps/charts)

When Permit Is Needed

  • Over 8'6" wide
  • Over 13'6" high
  • Trailer over 53' long

Special Information Needed

  • Registered weight of tractor, any overhang

Times Of Movement

  • Sunrise to sunset; 6 days a week (no Sunday travel) for permitted vehicles with over dimension and weight in excess of 94,500 lbs.
  • 16’ wide mobile homes: M-Th, 9am-2:30pm
  • Travel prohibited from noon on the weekday preceding until noon on the weekday after the following holidays: New Year’s Day, Memorial Day, Independence Day, Labor Day, Thanksgiving, Christmas
  • Curfews noted on permit

When Pilot/Escort Vehicle is Required

  • http://www.ncdot.org/doh/operations/dp%5Fchief%5Feng/maintenance/permits/pdf/EVOManual.pdf

For all over width movements on multi-lane highways:

  • 1 escort will be required for anything over 12'wide
  • Over 14’5” high-1front pilot w/ height pole
  • Over110’ long (superloads-100’)-1 rear pilot
  • Overhang over 14’-1 pilot
  • Weight over 149,999 lbs.-1 pilot
  • Multiple escorts possible for combination of over-dimensions
  • 16' wide mobiles with legal height and a maximum of 3" gutter edge are required to have 2 escorts on all controlled access highways
  • 3 escorts on all other multi-lane highways, and 3 escorts (1 being a law enforcement escort) on all 2 lane/2-way traffic roads plus proof of final destination

Superloads:

  • Over 15’ wide-3 pilots (1 NC Highway Patrol)

Requirements for Pilot/Escort Vehicle

  • General: Not less than 2000 lb.; load capacity of 17000 lb. or less
  • Signs: “OVERSIZE LOAD” or “WIDE LOAD” sign w/ black letters (10” high x 1 1/2” brush stoke) on yellow background mounted on bumper (must extend the entire length of bumper) or roof
  • Lights: Flashing amber lights (rotating sealed beam or strobe); 5”min. Diameter base; 4” min. Height; mounted on top of vehicle
  • Flags: Red or orange, 18” square
  • Additional equipment: Identification signs (8” x 12” min.) w/ name, address, phone# of operator/owner; on right & left side of vehicle.

Requirements for Pilot/Escort Vehicle Operator

  • All escort vehicle operators are required to obtain an approved escort certification priorto performing the duties of an oversize/overweight load escort vehicle operator in North Carolina and have completed NSC defensive course. Required course for all applicants: NCDOT OS/OW Load Escort Vehicle Operator Certification Program score of 75% min.; effective for 4 years; cost: $50.00. To make application call 888-221-8166.
  • Out-of -state operators that currently have valid driver’s license & certifications will be recognized.
  • No driver or passenger other than a certified escort vehicle operator is allowed to travel in the escort vehicle.
  • Dept. of Transportation Permits Office- Permit request by phone: Mon.-Fri. 7:30a.m.-4:00p.m. EST
  • DOT OS/OW Permit Unit (walk-in & mail)
  • 1425 Rock Quarry Road (I-40, Exit 300)
  • Suite 109-110
  • Raleigh, NC 27610
